transcript.text: Let me look up the specific operations for creating a source and triggering account aggregation in parallel.
Now let me get the full details on both key operations in parallel.

Here's the full walkthrough — four API calls total.

---

## Step 1 — Get a Bearer Token

All ISC API calls use OAuth2 client credentials. Exchange your PAT's `client_id`/`client_secret` for a token:

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
```

> Send credentials in the **body**, never in the query string. The response `access_token` goes into every subsequent request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

---

## Step 2 — Create the Source

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  "description": "Corporate LDAP directory",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "<owner-identity-id>",
    "name": "Jane Admin"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorName": "Active Directory",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "host": "ldap.corp.example.com",
    "port": 389,
    "baseDN": "dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com"
  },
  "authoritative": false,
  "deleteThreshold": 10
}
```

**Required fields:** `name`, `owner`, `connector`.

**Key optional fields:**
- `cluster` — tie the source to a specific VA cluster (required for on-prem connectors)
- `deleteThreshold` — safety cap; aggregation will halt rather than delete more than this % of accounts
- `authoritative` — marks this source as the system of record for identities

**Response** `201 Created` includes the new source's `id` — save it for step 3.

```json
{
  "id": "2c9180835d191a86015d28455b4b232a",
  "name": "My LDAP Source",
  ...
}
```

---

## Step 3 — Kick Off Account Aggregation

This is a **beta** endpoint, so you must include `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

No body is required for a standard (connector-driven) aggregation. Two optional body fields:

| Field | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `disableOptimization` | boolean | Force a full aggregation even if ISC would normally run an optimized/delta scan |
| `file` | multipart file | Supply an account feed file instead of connecting live (for DelimitedFile/CSV sources) |

**Response** `202 Accepted` — aggregation runs asynchronously:

```json
{
  "id": "2c91808474d2e4ae0174e70f9c700073",
  "type": "TASK_RESULT",
  "status": "PENDING"
}
```

Save the `id` for status polling.

---

## Step 4 — Poll Aggregation Status

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
```

Returns progress while the job is running:

```json
{
  "id": "2c91808474d2e4ae0174e70f9c700073",
  "status": "IN_PROGRESS",
  "totalAccounts": 1500,
  "processedAccounts": 843,
  "newAccounts": 12,
  "changedAccounts": 5,
  "deletedAccounts": 1
}
```

`status` will move through `PENDING` → `IN_PROGRESS` → `SUCCESS` (or `ERROR`). This endpoint only returns data while the job is active; once it completes it returns 404 — completion means done.

---

## Summary of the flow

```
POST /oauth/token                              → bearer token
POST /v3/sources                              → source.id
POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts   → aggregation.id
GET  /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status   → poll until done
```

**Scope required:** `idn:sources:manage` (covers both the create and the aggregation trigger).

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
    api_version: beta
  - method: GET
    path: /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status
    api_version: beta
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials via PAT)
required_scopes: [idn:sources:manage]
key_parameters: [name, owner, connector, sourceId, disableOptimization, file, id]
```
